tools.name: search_conferences
tools.description: Search academic conferences. Every parameter is optional — combine any of keyword, CCF/CORE/QUALIS rank, research field and submission/conference date ranges. Filter-only queries work fine (e.g. field=ai plus a submission-deadline window, no keyword). Returns a paginated list.

field.description: Research field (one of 14 computer-science areas, e.g. ai, security, systems)

updated_since.description: Incremental sync: only venues changed on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Day granularity. Use the updated_at field of the results as your next checkpoint.

tools.name: search_journals
tools.description: Search academic journals. Every parameter is optional — combine any of keyword, CCF rank, research field and ISSN. Returns a paginated list.

field.description: Research field (one of 14 computer-science areas, e.g. ai, security, systems)

updated_since.description: Incremental sync: only venues changed on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Day granularity. Use the updated_at field of the results as your next checkpoint.

tools.name: list_conferences
tools.description: Browse conference lists and rankings (open CFPs, ranked venues with a call open now, popularity, most competitive, etc.), paginated. No keyword filtering — use search_conferences for that.

ranking.description: cfp=open calls for papers; past_cfp=expired calls; ccf/core/qualis=venues in that tier whose submission deadline has not passed (for the whole tier catalogue use search_conferences with ccf_rank / core_rank / qualis_rank); most_viewed/most_tracked/most_attended=popularity; most_competitive=lowest acceptance rate; upcoming/past=by conference date; trending=most viewed in the last 30 days

tools.name: list_journals
tools.description: Browse journal lists and rankings (special-issue CFPs, CCF, highest impact factor, popularity, all), paginated. No keyword filtering — use search_journals for that.

ranking.description: cfp=special-issue calls for papers; ccf=CCF list; highest_if=highest impact factor; most_viewed/most_tracked=popularity; all=all journals

tools.name: get_conference
tools.description: Get full details of a conference by id: basics, CFP text, acceptance-rate history, edition history, structured ratings and comments, related conferences/journals. REQUIRES CREDENTIALS: Authorization: Bearer <credential> (free API key from https://www.myhuiban.com/account/api-keys, or a JWT from POST /api/login). responses link to the Conference Partner detail_page, not the venue's external website.

tools.name: get_journal
tools.description: Get full details of a journal by id: basics, CFP text, special issues, structured ratings and comments, related journals/conferences. REQUIRES CREDENTIALS: Authorization: Bearer <credential> (free API key from https://www.myhuiban.com/account/api-keys, or a JWT from POST /api/login). responses link to the Conference Partner detail_page, not the venue's external website.

tools.name: get_researcher
tools.description: Get a researcher's public profile by id: name, institution, auto-generated research-interest summary, CV, tracked/attended conferences and tracked journals. REQUIRES CREDENTIALS: Authorization: Bearer <credential> (free API key from https://www.myhuiban.com/account/api-keys, or a JWT from POST /api/login). Never includes contact details; by id only — there is no researcher search or enumeration.

tools.name: get_statistics
tools.description: Site-level public statistics: conference/journal totals, upcoming deadlines by month, conference country distribution, journal impact-factor and publisher distributions.
